events.title: 🚨 DISTRESS SIGNAL 🚨
events.description: Your comms crackle with a weak distress signal. A mining vessel is stranded, offering supplies in exchange for rescue. But it'll cost fuel. And time. {paranoid_chad_name} mutters about space pirates.
chad_reactions: {captain_name}: "I've always wanted to see Uranus up close!"

outcomes.message: ✅ SUCCESS: The chad was genuine. Grateful miners transfer supplies and share intel about safe routes. Heroism pays off.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "I told you it wasn't pirates. This time."

outcomes.message: ❌ TRAP: It was a pirate ambush! You barely escape with damaged hull and shaken chad.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {paranoid_chad_name}: "I TOLD you this was a trap!"

outcomes.message: 📡 You send a brief reply with your coordinates and continue on course. A small act of kindness.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {captain_name}: "We did what we could without risking the mission."

outcomes.message: 🔇 You ignore the distress signal and continue on course. The chad seems uneasy about leaving others behind.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "I hope we made the right choice..."

events.title: 🛸 MYSTERIOUS DERELICT 🛸
events.description: A massive derelict ship drifts in your path. Its hull shows signs of extreme age and unknown technology. {chad_name} suggests investigating, while {paranoid_chad_name} warns of potential dangers.
chad_reactions: {chad_name}: "This could be the discovery of a lifetime!"
{paranoid_chad_name}: "I don't like the look of this. Something's not right."
{engineer_name}: "The technology is unlike anything I've seen."

outcomes.message: 🎉 INCREDIBLE DISCOVERY: You find advanced technology and supplies. The chad is ecstatic about the find!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "This changes everything! We're going to be famous!"

outcomes.message: ⚠️ STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE: The ancient ship's hull gives way. You escape with damaged ship and shaken chad.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "I should have seen that coming. The structural integrity was compromised."

outcomes.message: 😱 HORROR DISCOVERY: You find evidence of a terrible fate that befell the previous chad. The discovery haunts your chad.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "I... I can't unsee what we found in there."

outcomes.message: 📡 Your scans reveal valuable data about the derelict. A safe but modest discovery.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "At least we got something useful without the risk."

outcomes.message: 📡 Your scans reveal nothing useful. The chad is disappointed by the missed opportunity.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "We'll never know what secrets that ship held."

outcomes.message: 🛣️ You plot a course around the derelict. Safe, but the chad wonders what they missed.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {captain_name}: "Sometimes the safest choice is the right choice."

events.title: ⚔️ CREW CONFLICT ⚔️
events.description: Tensions have been building between {chad_name} and {paranoid_chad_name}. Their disagreement about the mission approach has escalated into a heated argument that's affecting everyone's vibes.
chad_reactions: {chad_name}: "We need to take more risks to succeed!"

outcomes.message: ✅ RESOLUTION: Your support for calculated risks boosts chad confidence. They're ready to face challenges head-on.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Thank you for believing in us. We won't let you down!"

outcomes.message: ⚠️ RECKLESSNESS: The chad becomes overconfident and makes a costly mistake. Your ship takes damage.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {paranoid_chad_name}: "I told you this would happen!"

outcomes.message: ✅ STABILITY: Your emphasis on safety and planning restores chad harmony. They work together more efficiently.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {paranoid_chad_name}: "Finally, someone who understands the importance of being careful."

outcomes.message: 😔 CONSERVATISM: The chad becomes overly cautious and misses opportunities. Morale suffers from inaction.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "We're being too careful. We'll never reach Uranus at this rate."

outcomes.message: 🤝 DIPLOMACY: Your mediation skills bring the chad together. They learn to appreciate each other's perspectives.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {captain_name}: "You handled that perfectly. We're stronger as a team."

outcomes.message: 😤 STUBBORNNESS: Despite your best efforts, both chads remain stubborn. The tension continues.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Some people just can't be reasoned with."

events.title: ⚠️ RESOURCE SHORTAGE ⚠️
events.description: Your supplies are running dangerously low. {engineer_name} reports that the life support systems are struggling, and {chad_name} is starting to show signs of malnutrition. You need to make tough decisions about resource allocation.
chad_reactions: {engineer_name}: "The life support systems are at 60% efficiency. We need to act fast."
{chad_name}: "I'm starting to feel weak. We need more food."
{captain_name}: "We need to prioritize what's most critical."

outcomes.message: ⛽ FUEL SAVED: Your fuel conservation measures work, but the chad suffers from reduced rations.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "The fuel systems are stable, but the chad is getting weaker."

outcomes.message: ⚠️ SYSTEM FAILURE: The reduced power causes minor system failures. You save fuel but damage the ship.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "I warned you about reducing power to critical systems."

outcomes.message: 🍖 CREW RESTORED: The chad regains strength and vibes, but you burn extra fuel and strain the ship.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Thank you for putting our health first. We feel much better now."

outcomes.message: ⚠️ OVERCONSUMPTION: The chad overeats in their desperation, wasting resources and damaging systems.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "We need to be more disciplined with our resources."

outcomes.message: ⚖️ BALANCED SUCCESS: Your careful management improves all systems slightly. The chad appreciates your leadership.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {captain_name}: "You're doing an excellent job managing our resources."

outcomes.message: ❌ INEFFECTIVE: Your attempt to balance everything results in suboptimal outcomes across all systems.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "We need to make tough choices, not try to have it all."

events.title: 🌪️ SPACE STORM 🌪️
events.description: A massive electromagnetic storm approaches your ship. The readings are off the charts, and {engineer_name} is frantically trying to protect the ship's systems. {paranoid_chad_name} is convinced this is the end.
chad_reactions: {engineer_name}: "The storm is massive! We need to take immediate action!"
{paranoid_chad_name}: "This is it. We're all going to die out here."
{captain_name}: "Stay calm, everyone. We'll get through this."

outcomes.message: 🌪️ STORM SURVIVED: You weather the storm with significant damage but the chad is proud of their resilience.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {captain_name}: "We made it through! I'm proud of how we handled that."

outcomes.message: 💥 SEVERE DAMAGE: The storm causes extensive damage to your ship. The chad is shaken and demoralized.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "The damage is extensive. We're lucky to be alive."

outcomes.message: 🛸 EVASION SUCCESS: You successfully navigate around the storm, but it costs significant fuel.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Smart thinking! We avoided the worst of it."

outcomes.message: ⚠️ PARTIAL EXPOSURE: You can't fully evade the storm and still take some damage.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "We couldn't avoid it completely, but we minimized the damage."

outcomes.message: 🛡️ SHELTER FOUND: The asteroid provides partial protection, but you still take some damage.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "It's not perfect, but it's better than nothing."

outcomes.message: 💥 ASTEROID COLLISION: The asteroid field is more dangerous than the storm. You take significant damage.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {paranoid_chad_name}: "I knew this was a bad idea!"

events.title: 🪨 Asteroid Field Detected!
events.description: A dense asteroid field blocks your path ahead.

outcomes.message: 💥 You took damage navigating the asteroids! Hull integrity decreased by 20%.
✨ You skillfully navigated through the asteroid field unscathed!
🛣️ You safely avoided the asteroids but burned 50 extra fuel units.

events.title: 🤢 Medical Alert: Space Dysentery!
events.description: A chad has contracted space dysentery from contaminated water recycling.

outcomes.message: 😌 The chad recovered after a few uncomfortable days. Morale slightly decreased.
💀 The chad succumbed to space dysentery. The chad is devastated.

events.title: 🛸 Derelict Cargo Ship Detected!
events.description: Your scanners pick up a derelict cargo vessel drifting nearby. It appears abandoned.

outcomes.message: 🎁 Jackpot! You found 80 fuel cells and 40 food rations in the cargo hold! Salvaged tech worth 2 ETH.
💥 It was a trap! Automated defense systems damaged your ship by 15%.
🕳️ The ship was completely empty. You wasted time for nothing.
🚀 You continue on your journey without investigating.

events.title: ☢️ Radiation Storm Approaching!
events.description: A massive solar flare is sending a wave of radiation your way!

outcomes.message: 🛡️ Your shields protected the chad from radiation. 30 fuel consumed.
😰 The chad survived the radiation but vibes is low from the exposure.
💀 One chad succumbed to acute radiation sickness.
😅 The radiation wasn't as bad as feared. Minor vibes impact.

events.title: 🏴‍☠️ Space Pirates Demand Tribute!
events.description: A pirate vessel has locked weapons on your ship and demands you surrender cargo!

outcomes.message: 🍖 The pirates take 100 food rations and leave you in peace.
⚔️ You drove them off! Your Chad crew cheers and you looted 3 ETH and 20 fuel from their damaged ship!
💥 The pirates damaged your ship badly (30% hull) before fleeing. You lost 20 fuel in the battle.
💀 The pirates were stronger than expected. They killed a chad and dealt 40% hull damage before leaving.

events.title: 📡 Mysterious Signal Detected!
events.description: You're receiving a strange transmission from deep space. It seems... alien?

outcomes.message: 👽 You discovered an ancient alien fuel cache! +150 fuel. The chad is excited!
😱 The signal led to a terrifying alien artifact. The chad is deeply unsettled.
📻 The signal was just cosmic interference. Nothing found.
🚀 You decide to stick to the mission and continue toward Uranus.

events.title: ☄️ Meteor Shower Incoming!
events.description: Hundreds of small meteors are on a collision course with your ship!

outcomes.message: 🎯 Your pilot successfully evaded the meteor shower! 40 fuel consumed.
💫 Despite evasive action, a few meteors struck the hull. -10% hull, -40 fuel.
💥 The shields weren't enough. Multiple impacts reduced hull by 25%.
🛡️ The shields held! Only minor hull damage (5%).

events.title: 💧 Supply Leak Detected!
events.description: A storage compartment breach is causing resources to vent into space!

outcomes.message: 🔧 You managed to seal the leak but lost 30 food units in the process.
💥 The repair failed, making it worse! Lost 60 food and 10% hull integrity.
🚪 You sealed the compartment to prevent further loss. Lost 50 food and 30 fuel.

events.title: 🛰️ Trading Post Beacon!
events.description: A small automated trading station is offering to exchange goods.

choices.text: Trade food for fuel (50 food → 80 fuel)

outcomes.message: 🔄 Trade completed! -50 food, +80 fuel.

choices.text: Trade fuel for food (40 fuel → 60 food)

outcomes.message: 🔄 Trade completed! -40 fuel, +60 food.
🚀 You continue your journey without trading.

events.title: 🛰️ WARNING: Uranus Probe Required
events.description: Mission Control insists you must probe Uranus before landing. The chad is uncomfortable with the phrasing.

outcomes.message: 📡 The probe successfully entered Uranus. The chad won't stop giggling. -5 vibes from immaturity.
💥 The probe was destroyed by methane deposits in Uranus. The chad made it weird. -15 vibes, -20 fuel.
😎 The chad appreciates your maturity. Mission Control is disappointed in you. +10 vibes.

events.title: 📈 Incoming Transmission: HOT COIN TIP
events.description: An encrypted message promises 1000x gains on $URANUSCOIN. This seems legitimate and wise.

outcomes.message: 🚀 HOLY SHIT IT ACTUALLY MOONED! +500 fuel worth and 10 ETH! Your Chad crew are now insufferable about their market genius.
📉 The dev rugged. The liquidity is gone. Your fuel is gone. You lost 1.5 ETH. You are financially devastated.
😐 You continue your journey. Later, you hear $URANUSCOIN did a 50x. You'll never stop thinking about this.

events.title: 💨 Uranus Gas Leak Detected
events.description: A methane gas leak near Uranus is affecting ship operations. The gas fees are astronomical.

outcomes.message: ⛽ You paid 60 fuel in gas fees to navigate Uranus safely. This is somehow a metaphor.
⏳ The gas eventually dispersed. You wasted time and consumed 20 food waiting.
💨 The gas got worse. Your Chad crew is trapped in Uranus's gas cloud. -30 food, -15 vibes.

events.title: 🖼️ NFT Cargo Ship Discovered
events.description: You found a derelict ship carrying 10,000 procedurally generated Bored Ape Astronauts. They have no value.

outcomes.message: 📸 You now own every JPEG for free. The chad feels like they stole something. They didn't. +15 vibes.

choices.text: Respect the blockchain and leave them

outcomes.message: 😔 You respected property rights that don't exist in space. The chad thinks you're a mark. -10 vibes.

events.title: 💍 Uranus Rings Detected
events.description: Your sensors detect 13 faint rings around Uranus. Someone makes an onion rings joke. It doesn't land.

outcomes.message: ⛏️ You successfully extracted resources from Uranus's rings! +70 fuel, +30 food.
💥 Mining Uranus's rings was harder than expected. Your equipment got caught in the ring. -20% hull.
📷 You captured stunning images of Uranus's rings. The chad pretends they care about science. +5 vibes.

events.title: 💎 Chad Member Refuses to Sell $TITANICTOKEN
events.description: A chad invested life savings in $TITANICTOKEN. It's down 99.8%. They have diamond hands.

outcomes.message: 🙏 They finally sold at a 99.9% loss. This is somehow a win. The healing can begin. +20 vibes.
💎 They called you a paper-handed bitch and doubled down. This is fine. Everything is fine. -15 vibes.
📉 They're still checking the charts every 5 minutes. It's down another 40%. Math is cruel. -20 vibes.

events.title: 🎯 Calculating Entry Angle Into Uranus
events.description: The navigator is calculating the optimal angle to enter Uranus. The double entendres are excruciating.

outcomes.message: 🛸 You gently entered Uranus at a shallow angle. Everyone is being so mature about this. -40 fuel.
🎯 Perfect deep entry into Uranus! Fuel conserved. The chad maintains eye contact to assert dominance.
💥 You went too deep into Uranus! The pressure was intense. -30% hull. The jokes write themselves.

events.title: 🐋 Space Whale Detected (Market Manipulation)
events.description: A massive entity is dumping $URANUS tokens, crashing the market. It might also be an actual space whale.

outcomes.message: 📈 THE WHALE PUMPED IT! You caught the bounce! +200 fuel value! WAGMI! +25 vibes from euphoria!
📉 It kept dipping. Then it dipped more. Then it dipped through the floor into hell. -80 fuel, -20 vibes.
🎣 You harpooned the space whale! +200 food! This is probably illegal in 47 star systems.
🐋 The whale destroyed your harpoon and killed a chad. It then dumped more tokens. -25% hull, -1 chad.

events.title: 🔄 Uranus is in Retrograde
events.description: The astrology officer reports that Uranus is in retrograde. This affects nothing but she insists it matters.

outcomes.message: 🔮 You waited. Nothing happened differently. The astrology officer is vindicated somehow. -30 food, +5 vibes.
🚀 You continued without incident because astrology isn't real. The officer is sulking.
💫 You hit unexpected turbulence. The astrology officer says 'I TOLD YOU SO' for 6 hours straight. -40 fuel, -15 vibes.

events.title: 💩 Cargo Bay Inspection: Shitcoins Detected
events.description: You discover the cargo bay is 40% shitcoins some chad is trying to shill at Uranus.

outcomes.message: 🚮 You jettison $SCAMCOIN, $RUGPULL, and $TRUSTMEBRO into the void. One chad is crying. -10 vibes.
🤯 IMPOSSIBLY, SOMEONE AT URANUS BOUGHT THE BAGS! You traded shitcoins for +100 food! This never happens!
📉 No one at Uranus wants the shitcoins. The cargo space was wasted. The chad is split into factions. -20 vibes.

events.title: 👃 Sensors Detect Uranus Odor Profile
events.description: Chemical analysis reveals Uranus smells exactly like what you think. Hydrogen sulfide confirmed.

outcomes.message: 🚫 Ship sealed. The chad will never experience Uranus's natural aroma. This is a mercy. +5 vibes.
💀 The smell of Uranus is indescribable. One chad passed out and won't wake up. -1 chad, -30 vibes.

events.title: 🏊 ALERT: Liquid Oxygen Liquidity Pool Drained
events.description: Someone bridged all your liquid oxygen to a DEX on the Uranus blockchain. The liquidity is gone.

outcomes.message: 😰 You rationed air and synthesized O2 from fuel. Everyone is lightheaded but alive. -50 fuel, -15 vibes.
💀 The protocols failed. Two chads suffocated while checking if the liquidity returned. It didn't. -2 chad, -30 vibes.
💸 You bought back your own oxygen from the hacker at extortion prices. -100 food, -100 fuel. This is fine.

events.title: 📝 Colonist Naming Rights NFT Drop
events.description: The Uranus Authority is selling NFTs for colonist naming rights. Be among the first on Uranus!

outcomes.message: 🎫 You're now officially 'First Wave Uranus Colonist #6,847'! The serial number really makes it special. +20 vibes.
😐 You bought the NFT but the Uranus Authority site is down. Your receipt says 'RIGHT CLICK SAVE DEEZ NUTS'. -80 fuel, -10 vibes.
😎 You're colonizing Uranus for the adventure, not for a JPEG. The chad respects this.

events.title: 🌙 TO THE MOON! Wait...
events.description: The crypto bro you hired as navigator keeps trying to plot course to 'the moon.' You're going to URANUS.

outcomes.message: 🎯 Course corrected to Uranus. The navigator seems disappointed. 'But ser... wen moon?' -30 fuel wasted.

choices.text: Actually, let's check out the moon

outcomes.message: 🌙 You visited Earth's moon. It's covered in abandoned Dogecoin mining rigs. This was pointless. -200 fuel, +15 vibes.

events.title: 🔩 Structural Warning: Uranus Pressure Extreme
events.description: Your ship is experiencing intense pressure approaching Uranus. The hull is groaning audibly.

outcomes.message: 🔧 Hull reinforced. You withstood the pressure of Uranus. Your ship is no longer hull-compromised. -50 fuel.
💥 Reinforcement failed. Uranus's pressure was too intense. -35% hull, -50 fuel. Structural integrity questionable.
🔙 You pulled out of Uranus before things got worse. The chad questions your commitment. -40 fuel, -10 vibes.

events.title: 🌾 Crop Yield Farming vs DeFi Yield Farming
events.description: The engineer confused actual crop yield farming with DeFi yield farming. All crops are now staked on Uranus blockchain.

outcomes.message: 🌱 You unstaked the crops but they withered in smart contract. -30 food, -40 fuel in gas fees. Revolutionary technology.
🎰 Somehow the crops earned yield?? You have +50 food from staking rewards. DeFi makes zero sense. -40 fuel gas.
🚜 THE APY MOONED! Your crops are earning 42069% yield! +150 food! This is somehow legal! This is fine!
💀 The farm was a rug pull. Your crops are gone. You will starve on Uranus. This is what you get for trusting DeFi. -100 food.

events.title: ⚠️ Uranus Rotates Sideways (98° Axial Tilt)
events.description: Uranus rotates on its side like a complete weirdo. This is affecting your approach vector and also your worldview.

outcomes.message: 🌀 You matched Uranus's sideways rotation. Everyone is nauseous. The universe is chaos. -60 fuel.
🤢 You matched rotation but now the chad can't remember which way is up. Existential crisis aboard. -60 fuel, -20 vibes.
😎 You maintained dignity and normal orientation. Uranus can rotate however it wants. You're fine.
💫 Your orientation was wrong. You entered Uranus at a bad angle. This sounds worse than it is. -25% hull.

events.title: 📦 Cargo Hold Inspection: Physical Memecoins
events.description: Someone loaded the cargo hold with physical memecoin merchandise. 4 tons of Uranus-themed crypto merch.

outcomes.message: 🗑️ You dumped 4 tons of 'URANUS HODL' t-shirts into space. Somewhere, a marketing consultant is crying.

choices.text: Make chad wear the merch (assert dominance)

outcomes.message: 👕 Everyone now wears 'I SURVIVED URANUS' shirts. The irony is we haven't arrived yet. Morale is destroyed. -25 vibes.

choices.text: Try to sell it at Uranus

outcomes.message: 🤑 HOLY SHIT THERE'S A MARKET FOR THIS! You sold everything at 1000% markup! +300 food, +200 fuel!
😐 No one at Uranus wants 'DIAMOND HANDS ON URANUS' hoodies. You're stuck with 4 tons of regret. -15 vibes.

events.title: 🗳️ DAO VOTE: Ship Operations Now Decentralized
events.description: The chad formed a DAO. All decisions now require governance token votes. You no longer have unilateral control.

outcomes.message: 🤝 DAO governance is working! Chad vibes is high! Decisions take 6 hours but everyone feels heard! +20 vibes!
💀 The DAO voted to blow all fuel on NFTs. This is democracy. You have no power here. -50 fuel, -30 vibes from chaos.
👑 You dissolved the DAO and reasserted control. The chad calls you a tyrant. They're not wrong. -20 vibes.

events.title: 🌑 Uranus Has 27 Moons (This Seems Excessive)
events.description: Navigation is confused by Uranus's 27 moons. Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania, Oberon, and 22 others nobody remembers.

outcomes.message: 🔭 You found abandoned mining operations on Miranda! +100 food from supplies! -70 fuel from thoroughness.
😴 You scanned all 27 moons. They're all boring rocks. This took forever. -70 fuel. What a waste.
🎯 You stayed focused on Uranus. The moons can wait. You're here for the big prize.
💥 You ignored a moon and crashed into it. In your defense, there are 27 of them. -15% hull.

events.title: 📄 Paper Hands Mutiny in Progress
events.description: Half the chad wants to sell all resources and return to Earth. They have paper hands and weak spirits.

outcomes.message: 💎 Your speech about holding through adversity worked! The chad's hands crystallize into diamonds! +30 vibes! WAGMI!
📄 Your speech failed. 2 chads took an escape pod back to Earth. They sold at a loss. Ngmi. -2 chad, -25 vibes.

choices.text: Agree to return to Earth (give up)

outcomes.message: 😔 You turn back. You sold. Paper hands won. You'll never know what could have been. Game Over? -40 vibes, -300 fuel.

events.title: 🎨 Scientific Debate: What Color Is Uranus?
events.description: The chad is arguing whether Uranus is blue, cyan, or blue-green. This has halted all operations.

outcomes.message: 🔵 You declare Uranus is 'cyan-ish blue-green.' Everyone reluctantly accepts this wisdom. +10 vibes from closure.
💢 You picked the wrong color. The ship splits into factions. One scientist leaves in protest. -1 chad, -15 vibes.
🤷 The debate continues for days. No work gets done. Resources are consumed debating. -40 food wasted.

events.title: 🐛 CRITICAL: Smart Contract Bug in Life Support
events.description: Someone deployed life support systems to a smart contract. There's a reentrancy bug. Your oxygen is being drained infinitely.

outcomes.message: 👨‍💻 Patch deployed! The infinite loop stopped! You can breathe! Why was life support on blockchain?! -100 fuel for gas.
💀 Patch failed. 2 chads died in the infinite loop. This is what happens with unaudited contracts. -2 chad, -100 fuel, -35 vibes.
🔌 You unplugged the blockchain. Life support is now just... regular support. Everyone can breathe. +15 vibes from sanity.

events.title: 🌊 Discovery: Methane Oceans on Uranus
events.description: You discovered vast methane oceans on Uranus. This is scientifically unlikely but it's happening anyway.

outcomes.message: ⛽ You successfully harvested methane from Uranus! +200 fuel! Your ship now smells terrible but you're rich!
💥 The methane ocean exploded when you tried to harvest it. One chad lost. Science is dangerous. -30% hull, -1 chad.
🔬 You documented the methane oceans of Uranus. This discovery will change science. Also it's hilarious. +20 vibes.

events.title: ⚠️ SYSTEM ERROR: REALITY.EXE HAS STOPPED WORKING
events.description: The closer you get to Uranus, the more reality breaks down. The laws of physics are becoming suggestions. Causality is optional.

choices.text: Embrace the chaos (let go of reality)

outcomes.message: 🌀 You transcended physical limitations! Resources materialized from nothing! 3 dead chads came back! +500 fuel, +500 food, +50 vibes, +3 chad! NOTHING IS REAL!
💀 Reality rejected your embrace. Your ship is now partially in another dimension. The hull is quantum. -50% hull, -40 vibes from existential terror.
😱 You maintained sanity by rejecting what you see. Colors taste like numbers. Time is a circle. Uranus is both real and imaginary. -50 vibes from consciousness.

choices.text: Accept this is a simulation and request admin rights

outcomes.message: 🎮 CHEAT CODES ACCEPTED. You are now admin. All resources set to max. The simulation bends to your will. This is fine.
🤖 Request denied. You are not admin. You are the content. Continue to Uranus. This is your purpose. Resistance is futile.

events.title: 🧊 Ice Asteroid Detected!
events.description: A water-rich ice asteroid drifts nearby. You could extract fuel and drinking water.

outcomes.message: ⛏️ Success! You extracted 60 fuel cells and 30 food rations from the ice.
💥 A chunk of ice broke loose and damaged your equipment. -15% hull.
🕳️ The asteroid was mostly dust. Nothing useful found.
🚀 You continue on without mining.

events.title: 🛰️ Abandoned Probe Detected!
events.description: An old probe drifts silently. Its power cells might still hold usable fuel.

outcomes.message: 🎁 Jackpot! The probe's fuel cells are intact. +80 fuel. Salvaged components worth 1 ETH.
💥 A booby trap! The probe's defense systems activated. -15% hull.
🕳️ The probe was completely drained. Nothing useful.
🚀 You leave the probe alone and continue.

events.title: 🪨 Debris Field Ahead!
events.description: Wreckage from an old ship drifts in your path. Salvage could yield supplies.

outcomes.message: 🎁 You salvaged 50 fuel cells and 25 food rations from the debris! Scrap metal worth 1.75 ETH.
💥 Sharp debris punctured your hull during salvage. -20% hull.
🕳️ The wreckage was picked clean. Nothing useful.
🚀 You navigate carefully through the debris without stopping.

events.title: ☄️ Comet Tail Detected!
events.description: A comet's tail is rich in hydrogen. You could harvest it for fuel.

outcomes.message: ⛽ Success! You collected 70 fuel units from the comet tail.
☢️ Radiation exposure from the comet tail. The chad is shaken. -20 vibes.
🕳️ The gases were too diffuse. Nothing useful collected.
🚀 You plot a course around the comet and continue.

events.title: 🆘 Distress Beacon Detected!
events.description: A corporate vessel is stranded and offering a rescue bounty.

outcomes.message: 🎖️ Successful rescue! They paid 3.5 ETH. Your Chad crew feels heroic. +15 vibes.
😐 You rescued them, but they were broke. They paid you 1 ETH as an IOU.
💔 You left them to die. The chad questions your humanity. -10 vibes.

events.title: ☀️ Damaged Solar Collectors Detected!
events.description: Military-grade solar collectors drift nearby. They could be repaired for fuel conversion.

outcomes.message: ☀️ Success! The solar arrays are operational. They converted stored energy into 200 fuel units.
🔧 The collectors were badly damaged. You salvaged 50 fuel units from the power cells.
💔 The collectors were fried beyond repair. Nothing usable.
🚀 You leave the collectors behind and continue.

events.title: 🪐 Gas Giant Flyby Opportunity!
events.description: You're passing a hydrogen-rich gas giant. Atmospheric skimming could yield massive fuel.

outcomes.message: 🪐 Perfect skim! Your tanks are overflowing with hydrogen fuel. +300 fuel units!
🌪️ Turbulence made skimming difficult. You collected 100 fuel units before pulling out.
💥 Atmospheric entry was rougher than expected. You lost 30 fuel fighting gravity and gained nothing.
🚀 You admire the gas giant from a safe distance and continue.

events.title: 🌱 Escaped Hydroponic Pod Detected!
events.description: A commercial hydroponic pod drifts freely. Fresh vegetables are growing inside.

outcomes.message: 🥬 Fresh vegetables! Tomatoes, lettuce, potatoes! Your Chad crew feasts. +250 food units.
🍂 Most of the crops withered in space. You salvaged 75 food units of wilted produce.
🦠 The plants were contaminated with space mold. All produce destroyed for safety.
🚀 You leave the pod drifting and continue your journey.

events.title: 🥩 Protein Synthesizer Cache Found!
events.description: An abandoned cargo container holds protein synthesis equipment and raw materials.

outcomes.message: 🥩 The synthesizer churns out 200 units of protein bars. They taste like sadness, but they're nutritious.
⚙️ The synthesizer is damaged. It produces 50 units before breaking down completely.
💥 The synthesizer exploded on startup. Nothing salvaged. Your Chad crew mourns the lost protein.
🚀 You decide synthesized protein isn't worth the effort and continue.

events.title: ✨ Spectacular Aurora Nebula!
events.description: You've entered a nebula with breathtaking colors dancing across space. It's hauntingly beautiful.

outcomes.message: ✨ The chad gathers at the windows in awe. This is why you came to space. +25 vibes.
✨ Beautiful, but you've seen better nebulas. The chad appreciates the break. +10 vibes.
🚀 You continue through the nebula without stopping. The chad sighs.

events.title: 📻 Signal from Earth Detected!
events.description: You're picking up a music broadcast from Earth. It's playing hits from 2020.

outcomes.message: 🎵 The chad dances to songs from home. Someone cries. It's beautiful. +20 vibes.
🎸 They're playing your favorite song! The whole chad has a dance party. +30 vibes!
😢 The music makes everyone homesick. You turn it off but the damage is done. -10 vibes.
🚀 You mute the broadcast and stay focused on Uranus. The mission continues.

events.title: 💾 Encrypted Data Cache Found!
events.description: A data storage module floats nearby. Corporate entities pay well for recovered data.

outcomes.message: 💾 You cracked the encryption! The data contains corporate secrets worth 4 ETH on the black market.
🔓 Partial decryption. The fragmented data sells for 1.5 ETH to a research company.
🔒 The encryption is military-grade. You can't crack it. The data is worthless.
🚀 You leave the data cache alone. Who knows what surveillance it contains.

events.title: 💎 Rare Mineral Asteroid Detected!
events.description: Scanners show an asteroid rich in platinum and rare earth elements.

outcomes.message: 💎 Jackpot! Pure platinum veins. You extract minerals worth 5 ETH!
⛏️ Decent haul. You mined rare elements worth 2 ETH before the veins ran dry.
🪨 Your scanners lied. The asteroid is worthless iron and rock. Nothing valuable.
🚀 Mining takes too long. You leave the asteroid behind and continue.

events.title: 💧 HYDROGEN COLLECTOR ARRAY 💧
events.description: A commercial hydrogen collection array drifts abandoned in space. The storage tanks might still contain usable fuel for your engines.

outcomes.message: 💧 SUCCESS: Hydrogen tanks full! +100 fuel units!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "Clean hydrogen fuel. Perfect for our engines."

outcomes.message: ⚙️ PARTIAL: Collectors half-empty. Salvaged 50 fuel units.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "Still a good haul."

outcomes.message: 💥 LEAK: Hydrogen ignited during transfer! -5% hull damage.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Hydrogen is so volatile!"

outcomes.message: 🚀 You continue without harvesting.

events.title: ⛽ COMPRESSED FUEL PODS ⛽
events.description: Military-grade compressed fuel pods float in a neat formation. They must have been jettisoned from a cargo ship. Easy pickings.

outcomes.message: ⛽ SUCCESS: Military-grade fuel pods! +50 fuel units!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "This fuel is premium quality."

outcomes.message: ⚠️ LEAK: Most pods ruptured. Salvaged 15 fuel units.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "Better than nothing."

outcomes.message: 💨 EMPTY: All pods were already drained.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Someone beat us to it."

outcomes.message: 🚀 You continue without retrieving the pods.

events.title: ⚡ ANTIMATTER CONTAINMENT POD ⚡
events.description: DANGER: An antimatter containment pod from a research vessel. If extracted successfully, it's worth hundreds of fuel units. If the containment fails... well, don't think about that.

outcomes.message: ⚡ JACKPOT: Antimatter successfully contained! +300 fuel units! +20 vibes from the thrill!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "WE'RE RICH! And alive!"

outcomes.message: ⚙️ PARTIAL: Containment unstable. Got 150 fuel before aborting.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "Let's not push our luck."

outcomes.message: 💥 DISASTER: Containment breach! -30% hull, -20 vibes. You barely escaped!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "NEVER AGAIN!"

outcomes.message: 🚀 You wisely avoid the antimatter and continue.

events.title: 🧪 DEUTERIUM TANKER 🧪
events.description: An industrial deuterium tanker drifts abandoned. Deuterium is premium fusion fuel - if you can safely siphon it without radiation exposure.

outcomes.message: 🧪 SUCCESS: Clean deuterium fuel! +150 fuel units!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "This is the good stuff. Our reactor will love this."

outcomes.message: ⚙️ CONTAMINATED: Fuel is impure. Got 100 usable fuel units.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "I can filter this. It'll work."

outcomes.message: ☢️ RADIATION: The tanker leaked radiation. -10 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "I don't feel so good..."

outcomes.message: 🚀 You bypass the tanker and continue.

events.title: 🌿 AQUAPONICS POD 🌿
events.description: A commercial aquaponics pod floats ahead - fish and vegetable cultivation in zero-g. The systems appear to still be operational. Fresh food in space!

outcomes.message: 🌿 JACKPOT: Fresh fish and greens! +150 food, +10 vibes from fresh meal!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "FRESH FOOD! I forgot what this tastes like!"

outcomes.message: ⚙️ PARTIAL: Systems failing. Salvaged 60 food units, +5 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Still beats freeze-dried rations."

outcomes.message: 🦠 CONTAMINATED: All crops diseased. Had to jettison. -10 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "The smell... oh god, the smell..."

outcomes.message: 🚀 You continue without investigating.

events.title: 🦠 ALGAE FARM BIOREACTOR 🦠
events.description: A bioreactor module grows protein-rich algae for food production. It's not appetizing, but algae is nutritious and space-efficient.

outcomes.message: 🦠 SUCCESS: Protein-rich algae processed! +75 food units!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {engineer_name}: "It's not great, but it's food."

outcomes.message: 😐 DISGUSTING: Algae tastes terrible. +30 food, -5 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "This is punishment, not food."

outcomes.message: 💀 TOXIC: Algae was poisonous. Nothing usable.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Thank god we tested it first."

outcomes.message: 🚀 The chad refuses to eat algae. Continue on.

events.title: 🍄 MUSHROOM CULTIVATION POD 🍄
events.description: A biological research pod cultivates edible mushrooms. They grow quickly in zero-g and some species are quite nutritious. Probably.

outcomes.message: 🍄 SUCCESS: Edible mushrooms! +100 food units!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "These are actually pretty good!"

outcomes.message: 🍄 GOURMET: Rare truffle mushrooms! +60 food, +5 vibes from delicacy!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "This is gourmet quality!"

outcomes.message: 🍄 HALLUCINOGENIC: Wrong mushrooms! Chad tripped for hours. -15 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "I saw infinity. It was... unsettling."

outcomes.message: 🚀 You wisely avoid unknown mushrooms.

events.title: 🎮 ENTERTAINMENT ARCHIVE 🎮
events.description: A data cache from an entertainment corporation. Movies, music, games - all the creature comforts of Earth. Your Chad crew could use a vibes boost.

outcomes.message: 🎮 SUCCESS: Movies, games, music! Chad vibes soars! +20 vibes!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Movie night every night!"

outcomes.message: 🎸 JACKPOT: Your favorite band's entire discography! +30 vibes!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "THIS IS MY JAM!"

outcomes.message: 😐 BORING: Just documentaries about tax law. -5 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Why does this even exist?"

outcomes.message: 🚀 No time for entertainment. Continue on.

events.title: 🛥️ LUXURY YACHT WRECKAGE 🛥️
events.description: The wreckage of a luxury space yacht floats in debris. The wealthy passengers left behind gourmet food, expensive valuables, and a tragic story.

outcomes.message: 🛥️ JACKPOT: Gourmet food and valuables! +75 food, +2 ETH, +15 vibes!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Caviar! Champagne! This is the life!"

outcomes.message: ⚙️ PARTIAL: Some supplies left. +30 food, +1 ETH, +10 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Still some nice stuff here."

outcomes.message: 😢 TRAGIC: Found bodies of wealthy family. -10 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "Money couldn't save them."

outcomes.message: 😇 You leave the wreckage undisturbed. +5 vibes for honoring the dead.

events.title: 🆘 ESCAPE POD WITH SURVIVORS 🆘
events.description: An escape pod contains survivors from a destroyed ship. They're running out of air and supplies. Rescuing them will cost resources but save lives.

outcomes.message: 🆘 RESCUE: Survivors grateful! Used -30 fuel, -60 food. +25 vibes boost!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "We saved lives today. That's what matters."

outcomes.message: 🎖️ REWARD: Survivors were VIPs! -30 fuel, -60 food, +3 ETH, +20 vibes!
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "They're incredibly grateful. And rich!"

outcomes.message: 😰 BURDEN: Survivors are demanding. -30 fuel, -60 food, -20 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "These people are insufferable!"

outcomes.message: 💔 You left them behind. The chad is horrified. -15 vibes.
outcomes.chad_reaction: {chad_name}: "I can't believe we just did that..."
